tool.name: m365_tenant_recon
tool.description:
Detect Microsoft 365 / Azure AD (Entra ID) tenant + federation posture for a domain.
Probes two public Microsoft endpoints (no authentication required):
1. **OpenID Connect discovery** — `https://login.microsoftonline.com//.well-known/openid-configuration` When the domain is a registered Entra tenant, returns the standard OIDC discovery JSON. The `issuer` URL contains the tenant GUID — the pivot key for every downstream Azure-resource probe.
2. **GetUserRealm** — `https://login.microsoftonline.com/getuserrealm.srf?login=user@&xml=1` Returns XML with `NameSpaceType` (Managed / Federated / Unknown), `FederationBrandName` (when federated; names the IdP — ADFS / Okta / Ping / etc.), and the canonical domain (Microsoft's view of the tenant's primary domain).
Findings: - **Info** (CWE-200, info_disclosure) when the domain is a confirmed Entra tenant. The finding includes the tenant ID, federation type, and IdP brand. Tailored `description_plain` + `recommended_action` based on whether the tenant is Managed (direct M365), Federated (third-party IdP via SAML/WS-Fed), or Unknown.
Use during the recon phase for any `domain` target that the agent suspects might have email / collaboration on M365. The two probes are cheap (one GET each) and add no false positives — Microsoft definitively answers "is this domain an Entra tenant?" via these endpoints.
Composes with cluster-A safety. The probe targets Microsoft endpoints (not the customer), so `--exclude-path` against the customer's domain doesn't apply, but `--rate-limit` still throttles outbound calls.

parameter.name: domain
parameter.description: Apex domain to probe (e.g. `example.com` or `contoso.onmicrosoft.com`). Bare hostnames only — schemes are stripped if accidentally included.

returns.description:
{success, domain, is_m365_tenant, tenant_id, openid_configuration: {url, present, status, tenant_id, issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, jwks_uri, ...}, user_realm: {url, present, status, namespace_type, federation_brand, federation_protocol, auth_url, canonical_domain, ...}}.
`is_m365_tenant=True` when EITHER probe confirms (some tenants only respond to one). `tenant_id` is the GUID extracted from the OIDC issuer URL; None when only the realm probe succeeded.
